input.summary: Delete the one-way 24-month non-solicit/no-hire binding Customer
input.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted Section 12.4: our position is that Customer takes no non-solicitation restriction, and this one-way 24-month bar on soliciting, hiring or employing any Vendor employee (with no general-advertising carve-out) is a no-hire that also contradicts Section 12.3. If you need something here, we can accept a mutual non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services for 12 months after their involvement ends, carving out general advertisements and unsolicited approaches, with no no-hire.
